title: Density zero of M ∖ A at a point where A ⊆ M have the same approximate tangent plane
statement: Let P, N ∈ ℕ, A ⊆ M ⊆ ℝ^P with A Borel, x ∈ ℝ^P, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P, and s > 0 with H^N(M ∩ B̄_s(x)) < ∞ (H^N = μHE[N], B̄_s(x) = closedBall x s). Suppose M and A both have approximate tangent space Q at x (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt N M x Q and HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt N A x Q; Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4). Then H^N((M ∖ A) ∩ B_r(x))/r^N → 0 as r ↓ 0, where B_r(x) = ball x r and the quotient is taken in [0, ∞] with r^N entered as ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ N).
lean_statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (A M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (s : ℝ), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ M → 0 < s → μHE[N] (M ∩ closedBall x s) ≠ ∞ → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt N M x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt N A x Q → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μHE[N] ((M \ A) ∩ ball x r) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ N)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
